1.web: King Solomon was king over all Israel.
1.asv: And king Solomon was king over all Israel.

2.web: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
2.asv: And these were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

3.web: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
3.asv: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

4.web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
4.asv: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

5.web: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;
5.asv: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, and the king’s friend;

6.web: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
6.asv: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to taskwork.

7.web: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
7.asv: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided victuals for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

8.web: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;
8.asv: And these are their names: Ben-hur, in the hill-country of Ephraim;

9.web: Ben Deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
9.asv: Ben-deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

10.web: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (to him belonged Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);
10.asv: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth (to him pertained Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);

11.web: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
11.asv: Ben-abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife);

12.web: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
12.asv: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

13.web: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (to him belonged the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him belonged the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);
13.asv: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead (to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; even to him pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brazen bars);

14.web: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
14.asv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

15.web: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
15.asv: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon to wife);

16.web: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
16.asv: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

17.web: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
17.asv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

18.web: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
18.asv: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

19.web: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
19.asv: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer that was in the land.

20.web: Judah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
20.asv: Judah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

21.web: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt: they brought tribute, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
21.asv: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought tribute, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

22.web: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and sixty measures of meal,
22.asv: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

23.web: ten head of fat cattle, and twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, besides deer, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fattened fowl.
23.asv: ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and a hundred sheep, besides harts, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fatted fowl.

24.web: For he had dominion over all on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides around him.
24.asv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

25.web: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
25.asv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig-tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

26.web: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
26.asv: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

27.web: Those officers provided food for king Solomon, and for all who came to king Solomon’s table, every man in his month; they let nothing be lacking.
27.asv: And those officers provided victuals for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month; they let nothing be lacking.

28.web: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they to the place where the officers were, every man according to his duty.
28.asv: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

29.web: God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and very great understanding, even as the sand that is on the seashore.
29.asv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea-shore.

30.web: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
30.asv: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

31.web: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations all around.
31.asv: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations round about.

32.web: He spoke three thousand proverbs; and his songs were one thousand five.
32.asv: And he spake three thousand proverbs; and his songs were a thousand and five.

33.web: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that springs out of the wall; he spoke also of animals, and of birds, and of creeping things, and of fish.
33.asv: And he spake of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall; he spake also of beasts, and of birds, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

34.web: There came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
34.asv: And there came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
